meta.description: Turn any picture into a brick-mosaic puzzle. Race the clock, answer art quizzes and challenge your friends.

footer.disclaimer: Legart is a non-commercial fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the LEGO Group.

home.title: Brick art puzzles
home.subtitle: Masterpieces and your own photos rebuilt from colourful bricks — piece them back together against the clock.
home.how1: Pick a painting or upload a photo — it becomes a brick mosaic.
home.how2: Choose pieces, square or jigsaw, and a difficulty. Then race the clock.
home.how3: Answer the art quiz, share your time and challenge friends.
home.joinHint: Enter the 6-character code a friend sent you.

library.title: Renaissance library

modeHelp.easy: No rotation, faint picture on the board, correct pieces lock with a ✓, edge pieces first, unlimited hints.
modeHelp.hard: Pieces are rotated (tap to turn). Correct pieces lock silently. Peeking costs 5 s, 3 hints at 10 s each. Score ×2.
modeHelp.expert: Rotation, no grid, nothing locks and no feedback until the end. One 3-second peek (+15 s). Score ×3.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.local: Without an account, your photos, history and records stay in this browser (IndexedDB). Nothing is uploaded.
privacy.cloud: With an account, photos you choose to save are stored privately and only you can open them. Location data (EXIF) is removed before upload.
privacy.public: Challenges and share links are public: anyone with the link can see the picture, your display name and your time.
privacy.delete: You can delete photos at any time and delete your account (with all data) from the “Me” page.
privacy.analytics: This site uses no advertising or tracking cookies.
